CEILING AIR DEVICES TO BUY: 31 units total (28 ceiling supply diffusers + 3 ceiling return/exhaust grilles). All are Price Industries per the GRILLES schedule on M601; counts are taken off the 49 hexagon tags on M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan, 1/8"=1'-0").

SUPPLY — CEILING DIFFUSERS (28):
- Type A — Price SCD, 6" round neck, white, 4-way: 5 ea (75, 130, 75, 90, 75 CFM)
- Type B — Price SCD, 8" round neck, white, 4-way: 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
- Type C — Price SCD, 10" round neck, white, 4-way: 15 ea (2 @ 200, 4 @ 250, 2 @ 300, 3 @ 350, 4 @ 375 CFM)
- Type D — Price SCD, 12" round neck, white, 4-way: 1 ea (500 CFM)
- Type J — Price SMD, 12 x 12 face with 8" round neck, white, 4-way: 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM)

A/B/C/D are louvered-face square 4-cone steel diffusers, 360-degree fixed discharge, supplied in a 24 x 24 panel for lay-in ceiling (note 5), with full-faced louvers and a factory-insulated backpan (note 1). Each needs a radial balancing damper in the neck — Price VCR9 or equal (note 12) — and connection per the ceiling grille duct connection detail (note 8). Type J is the high-capacity ceiling diffuser with a flanged frame for SURFACE mounting (note 6) and an opposed blade damper (note 4) — those 3 land in the gyp-board ceilings at the toilets/showers/janitor, which A6-1 confirms are GYP CEILING BOARD rather than lay-in.

RETURN / EXHAUST — CEILING (3):
- Type F — Price 80, 24" x 24" core, white: 3 ea. All-aluminum 1/2" x 1/2" x 1/2" egg crate exhaust/return grille, core-only panel in a 24 x 24 lay-in ceiling panel (notes 3, 5, 9). M101 note 4 also requires a new 24 x 24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum atop each new return grille — price that separately, it is not part of the grille.

All ceiling units are NC 35 max (note 7) and white finish, so no field painting on these.

ALSO CEILING-MOUNTED BUT NOT A SEPARATE GRILLE BUY: EF-1 and EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM each) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) are centrifugal ceiling exhaust fans furnished WITH an integral grille, flapper backdraft damper, plug-and-cord set, mounting brackets and a factory grille-mounted motion sensor (M601 exhaust fan schedule, note 1). Their tags appear on M101 as a dash over the CFM. Do not order grilles for these three.

NOT CEILING — do not include in your ceiling count (15 wall units): Type E, 4 ea Price *95, 30 x 18; Type G, 4 ea Price 95, 36 x 36 (wall transfer grilles, top at 14'-8" AFF per M101 note 3); Type H, 3 ea Price 520D, 18 x 8 @ 550 CFM; Type I, 4 ea Price *520D, 14 x 8 @ 450 CFM. These are all sidewall grilles/registers, primecoat finish, and will need 2 coats of field paint with color verified by the architect (note 13). E and I carry an asterisk = FIELD VERIFY EXACT GRILLE DIMENSION PRIOR TO ORDERING.

AIRFLOW CHECK: ceiling supply totals 6,550 CFM (A 445 + B 580 + C 4,550 + D 500 + J 475). Adding the sidewall supply (H 1,650 + I 1,800) gives exactly 10,000 CFM total supply, which is a clean check that the takeoff is complete. The 49 tags reconcile as 31 ceiling + 15 sidewall + 3 exhaust-fan integral grilles.

The grille is still new, so the count above stands, but carry the transition labor. (2) A6-1 shows part of the lay-in ceiling as "ALT. NO. 2 ACT" — the ceiling is in an alternate. The diffuser quantities do not change, but confirm which alternate the ceiling grid falls under before you commit panel-type-specific borders.
